<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="chaos-elemental-basic" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Chaos Elemental Basic</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/wdEqnvjshG.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
Note: a </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Table of Contents</nowiki></strong><nowiki> can be found in the pins.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>A being of pure chaos that resides to the west of the Rogues' Castle located in deep Wilderness. The Chaos Elemental is a beginner-friendly boss with simple mechanics meant to disorient the player more than harm them.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="how-to-get-there"><ins><nowiki>How to Get There</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>WARNING: THIS BOSS IS LOCATED IN THE WILDERNESS, BE SURE TO HAVE PVP TOGGLED </nowiki><em><nowiki>OFF</nowiki></em><nowiki> BEFORE ATTEMPTING TO FIGHT IT.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The level 50 Wilderness Obelisk is located east of the Chaos Elemental, easily accessed with the Portable Obelisk </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137735861937655900.png?v=1" alt="portableobelisk" title="portableobelisk" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Obelisk Shards, or any of the other Wilderness Obelisks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These options will teleport the player to a random Wilderness Obelisk unless they have the hard Wilderness area tasks completed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The teleport levers located in Edgeville </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032552323903402024.png?v=1" alt="edgevillelode" title="edgevillelode" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Ardougne </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032552315724517507.png?v=1" alt="ardougnelode" title="ardougnelode" kind="icon" /><nowiki> teleport the player to the Deserted Keep, located west of the Chaos Elemental.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=aYihp5v5prjLizw4mZiC <nowiki>Basic Ranged Preset</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/5dd9759ca25b37810be84f7c0f9398e1a75ab232a2db29c66a6442c3723821c1.webp" alt="Chaos Elemental basic Ranged" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=vg8oUa5bKInp1QL6BNuu <nowiki>Basic Necromancy Preset</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fvg8oUa5bKInp1QL6BNuu.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Summer Pies are used due to them leaving a Pie Dish in the player's inventory, keeping it full to avoid the Chaos Elemental's Madness attack.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="mechanics"><ins><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>



</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Discord</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>The Chaos Elemental's basic attack, made up of green particles that deal either </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage to the player. His other attacks are variations of this move with different effects.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Madness</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ The Chaos Elemental launches a multicoloured attack. Upon hit, the player's main hand weapon and up to 3 other pieces of equipped gear will be unequipped and placed in their inventory.
    • If the player's inventory is full, the Chaos Elemental will not use this attack
    • </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/gNKxb57aQz.mp4 <nowiki>Click to view an example of Madness</nowiki>]<nowiki>.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Confusion</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ The Chaos Elemental launches an attack made of fire. Upon hit, the player will be teleported upwards of 20 tiles away from Chaos Elemental in a random direction.
    • The player will stop attacking the boss after being teleported, be sure to click on the Chaos Elemental once this happens to resume attacking.
    • </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/8OQ7OtVZhR.mp4 <nowiki>Click to view an example of Confusion</nowiki>]<nowiki>
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="tips-and-tricks"><ins><nowiki>Tips and Tricks</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> hit of Discord is the most accurate, making it best to either Protect from Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551456835768351.png?v=1" alt="protectfrommagic" title="protectfrommagic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or Soul Split </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> throughout the fight.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Prioritize using powerful threshold abilities, only using basic abilities to build up to stronger ones, or when better options are on cooldown.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For Ranged </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> examples of powerful abilities are Snap Shot </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1" alt="snap" title="snap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Rapid Fire </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, with abilities like Dazing Shot </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541307142307860.png?v=1" alt="dazing" title="dazing" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Piercing Shot </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538450944.png?v=1" alt="piercing" title="piercing" kind="icon" /><nowiki> being your weaker basics. Death's Swiftness </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1" alt="deathsswift" title="deathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is a very powerful ability, but should only be used near the start of the fight, if you find yourself with </nowiki><em><nowiki>too much</nowiki></em><nowiki> adrenaline.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For Necromancy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> build up to abilities like Volley of Souls </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1" alt="volleyofsouls" title="volleyofsouls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Finger of Death </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1" alt="fingerofdeath" title="fingerofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with your weaker abilities, Soul Sap </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1" alt="soulsap" title="soulsap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Touch of Death </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1" alt="touchofdeath" title="touchofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, using your Basic Attack </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1" alt="necrobasic" title="necrobasic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> when all else is on cooldown.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If possible, keep your inventory full of items to avoid the Madness special attack, Chaos Elemental's drops can be used to fill any blank spaces.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ An NPC named Edward, located outside the Dragonkin Laboratory, south-east of the level 50 Wilderness Obelisk, can be used as a bank to store any drops the player receives and resupply for longer trips.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Due to the Chaos Elemental being located in the Wilderness, all Wilderness based bonuses granted by the Infernal Puzzle Box </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1" alt="infernalpuzzlebox" title="infernalpuzzlebox" kind="icon" /><nowiki> work against this boss.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
